_comment: A broken deep cavalry block whose front rank starts only 40 wu short of a hill keeps its front rank with it. Team 1's 80 horses (default Cavalry geometry: 9 files by 9 ranks, about 320 wu wide and 960 wu deep, rank pitch 120 wu) spawn ALREADY routing (starting_state 3, morale 1.0) facing south, their own back edge, with their front rank at y 1180 and a hill (block terrain, x 780-1040, y 1220-1420) across the eastern half of the block. This is deep-router-rounds-hill.json's staging with the hill moved 180 wu closer (that clip's first draft). The flight's step rounds the hill from the anchor, which is 480 wu behind the front rank, so the front rank meets the hill's north face before the bounded heading turn has swung it clear. The anchor travels west along the face while the front rank's line, grown by its half-width, would run onto it, so the whole block side-steps with its men on their slots, then runs on round the hill. A man also takes part of the change in his own feed-forward on top of his acceleration while it is not slowing: none within 60 wu (3 m) of his slot, rising to all of it from 120 wu (6 m) off (SoldierBodies.flight_accel_share), so the leading men the face held back no longer lose ground as the flight swings round the hill. Figures from full state dumps at the declared ticks, seeds 0 to 4 (all identical: nothing here draws on the seed), each labelled with the tree it was measured on. slot_distance_max (the farthest any man stands from his slot) at ticks 300 and 350: 325.1 and 382.5 wu on c6475b82, before the side-step, with 5 men more than 100 wu off at tick 350 (front-rank men i0-i3 pinned on the face and sliding west along it until about tick 240; measured by the side-step's own PR, not re-measured here); 143.0 and 192.3 wu, with 2 men more than a rank pitch (120 wu) off at tick 350, measured 2026-11-05 on main 806be006 (side-step, no share); 89.9 and 96.7 wu, with no man more than a rank pitch off at any declared tick, measured 2026-11-06 on d2b7e7b4 (side-step and share) against main 806be006. The slot_distance_max pins allow two rank pitches (240 wu), which c6475b82 exceeds at both ticks; 806be006 and this branch read well under them (at most 192.3 and 96.7 wu). The anchor's tick-240 position pin reads (687.3, 811.1) on 806be006 and (686.95, 811.33) on this branch, against (701.8, 911.3) on c6475b82: the side-step shows as 100 wu less travel south. The leading men still touch the face for a while (soldiers_at_block_terrain_edge 4, 3, 2 at ticks 120, 150, 180 on both 806be006 and this branch), since a block starting this close and from rest cannot stop short of it. The tick-8 position pins are setup pins (the spawn), not claims about the fix. A routing unit's rout timer (6 s) runs out at tick 360 and it rallies; the clip ends at tick 352, just before that. A small idle team-0 squadron 600 wu east keeps the router in the close sim tier; all_teams_control leaves both sides without AI. Flat declared map apart from the hill; drill mode. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
